reply.text: {"say":"Arms it is: triceps work is built around the long head with two overhead extensions leading, one pushdown for a different angle, then three biceps curls from varied angles.","title":"Arms: Long Head Triceps","days":[{"name":"Arms","exercises":[{"key":"ez-bar-overhead-triceps-extension","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Elbows in, deep stretch behind the head.Lot"},{"key":"barbell-biceps-curl","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"No swinging, control the lowering."},{"key":"single-arm-cable-overhead-triceps-extension","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Face away from the stack, full stretch."},{"key":"dumbbell-incline-curl","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Let arms hang back for the stretch."},{"key":"cable-rope-pushdown","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Spread the rope at the bottom."},{"key":"dumbbell-hammer-curl","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Neutral grip, elbows pinned."}]}],"unmet":[]}
